tags.name: Cabana
tags.wheelchair:description: It can get crowded and there's a little too much furniture to be easily accessible for anyone in anything larger than a manual chair. That said, the staff are very good and will readily move things out of the way for you.

tags.name: Shepherd's Bush
tags.wheelchair:description: London Overground only. Access from platform to train by manual boarding ramp. Use the ticket hall entrance for both platforms.

tags.description: Formerly Edwards; Beaumont Arms. The present building dates from 1884/5 but there has been a public house on this site from at least 1826.
